 West Balustrades Pty Ltd is an established metal fabrication company with over 20 years of experience servicing the building and construction industry in Sydney. We specialise in architectural metalworks such as balustrades, handrails, awnings, pergolas, privacy screens, louvres, gates, fencing, etc. We use glass, aluminium, stainless steel and mild steel in our metal fabrications. 

 Although we are a fully Australian-owned company based in Prestons, we work on projects all over Sydney. We are currently seeking experienced Welders / Metal Fabricators to join our growing team on a full-time, permanent basis. 

 This role offers a great opportunity to utilise your skill, knowledge, and/or qualifications in welding / metal fabrication in a progressive and successful company. For more information about our company, visit our website:  www.westbalustrades.com.au  

   

  Job Description  

 Successful applicants must be able to carry out the following duties: 

 
	 Welding stainless steel, mild steel and aluminium sections using various welding techniques including TIG and MIG. 
	 studying blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job requirements 
	 selecting, cleaning and preparing metal stock 
	 cutting marked-out metal sections and shapes using hand tools, flame cutting torches and metal cutting machines 
	 aligning parts to be joined using hand tools and measuring instruments 
	 joining metal sections using various welding techniques, screwing, bolting and riveting 
	 examining welds for width of bead, penetration and precision 
	 finishing products by cleaning, polishing, filing and bathing in acidic solutions

	 Installing and fitting fabricated metal works onto building structures, whilst ensuring all metal works are level, plumb, square and true.

  Qualifications and Experience

	 AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3), or 
	 AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or 
	 Minimum 3 years of experience in metal fabrication.

 $80,000 per annum + Superannuation

 Applications will be accepted for a minimum of 1 month from placement of this advertisement.
